NFL stadiums and neutral-site venues

Source: R/data.R
nfl_stadiums.Rd

One row per venue used by the bundled schedule sample, keyed by the nflverse stadium_id. Coordinates are stadium coordinates in decimal degrees (WGS84) with an IANA time zone, so travel distance runs with no network access. The table covers all 30 NFL venues plus the international and neutral sites used in 2024-2025.

Usage

nfl_stadiums

Format

A tibble with 37 rows and 7 variables:

stadium_id

nflverse stadium identifier (e.g. "KAN00").

stadium

Venue name.

city

City the venue sits in.

country

Country the venue sits in.

latitude

Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude

Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

time_zone

IANA time zone name (e.g. "Europe/London").

Source

Coordinates taken from the Wikipedia article for each venue; see data-raw/nfl_stadiums.R for the build script.

Details

DUB01 (Croke Park), BER01 (Olympiastadion) and MAD01 (Santiago Bernabeu Stadium) are nflrest identifiers. nflverse did not record the 2025 Dublin, Berlin, and Madrid venues in load_schedules() when the bundled sample was built, so data-raw/process_data.R maps those games here.

Examples

nfl_stadiums
#> # A tibble: 37 x 7
#>    stadium_id stadium                 city  country latitude longitude time_zone
#>    <chr>      <chr>                   <chr> <chr>      <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>    
#>  1 ATL97      Mercedes-Benz Stadium   Atla~ United~     33.8     -84.4 America/~
#>  2 BAL00      M&T Bank Stadium        Balt~ United~     39.3     -76.6 America/~
#>  3 BER01      Olympiastadion          Berl~ Germany     52.5      13.2 Europe/B~
#>  4 BOS00      Gillette Stadium        Foxb~ United~     42.1     -71.3 America/~
#>  5 BUF00      Highmark Stadium        Orch~ United~     42.8     -78.8 America/~
#>  6 CAR00      Bank of America Stadium Char~ United~     35.2     -80.9 America/~
#>  7 CHI98      Soldier Field           Chic~ United~     41.9     -87.6 America/~
#>  8 CIN00      Paycor Stadium          Cinc~ United~     39.1     -84.5 America/~
#>  9 CLE00      Huntington Bank Field   Clev~ United~     41.5     -81.7 America/~
#> 10 DAL00      AT&T Stadium            Arli~ United~     32.7     -97.1 America/~
#> # i 27 more rows

# Venues outside the United States
subset(nfl_stadiums, country != "United States")
